findings.reader: A well-built bounded news article: the coordinator-model-tools-server chain is visible and causally complete, the GreyNoise-claims versus PaperCut-confirmations boundary is maintained in every paragraph including the headline and cocktail-party line, terms are defined at first use, and actions are role-specific and proportionate. Explain-back and a novel hospital transfer scenario both succeed on the article's own material.
findings.facts: Fact-checking against all three source excerpts confirms the article: counts, dates, timeline, release versions, the Codex-harness/DeepSeek-model distinction, the vendor's explicit non-verification and the unknown motive are all rendered accurately with attribution preserved. Three plain-language definitions (harness, AI agent, domain administrator) are accurate editorial glosses not verbatim in the sources, marked qualified. No claim is contradicted or overstated.
